newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to finance state bank privatizations.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to finance state bank privatizations.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank will create a special credit line to finance the acquisition of state banks, Gazeta Mercantil financial newspaper said.
Investors will pay interest of two percent a year plus the overnight call money rate, it said.
The new credit line is part of a package of government measures to facilitate the sell-off of banks belonging to the states, Gazeta said.

On Saturday, the Brazilian government published a decree allowing federal banks Banco do Brasil, Caixa Economica Federal and the National Development Bank (BNDES) to buy up credits from state banks with plans to restructure and be sold.
